S0.name: Original Chronological Test Set
S0.governance_notes: Historical baseline metrics were previously recorded in Gate G1 artifacts. Preserves historical record; strictly quarantined against tuning, feature selection, or proposal ranking.
S0.data_use_rules: Quarantined benchmark only. Models and policies must never be tuned on S0.

S1.name: Late-Period Chronological Test Scenario
S1.description: Final chronological portion of the test period defined by TransactionDT >= 14,800,000 (approximately the final 28% of the test timeline).
S1.governance_notes: Pre-registered late-period scenario testing long-horizon temporal degradation. Defined strictly in advance by time boundary, without label inspection.
S1.data_use_rules: Evaluated only at final system evaluation gate; zero tuning allowed.

S2.name: Constructed Real-Data Shift (Validation Window Slice)
S2.description: Late chronological half of the validation partition (TransactionDT >= 11,315,422). Constructed from real transactions held out from model training and calibration.
S2.governance_notes: Constructed purely from real transactions within the permitted validation partition. Zero exposure to the test partition.
S2.data_use_rules: Permitted for replay gate testing, sentinel trigger validation, and threshold verification.

S3.name: Synthetic Perturbation Scenario
S3.description: Controlled synthetic stress test applying deterministic feature scaling and Gaussian noise injection (seed=42) to validation partition features.
S3.governance_notes: Deterministic synthetic perturbation. MUST be labeled synthetic, never natural drift. Does not constitute proof of robustness against all real-world shifts.
S3.data_use_rules: Permitted for invariant testing, Red-Teamer evaluations, and replay verification.
